name: Campbell Murray
biography: Campbell Murray is the global head of BlackBerry Cybersecurity Delivery and joined the organization through the acquisition of Encription Ltd, of which he was a founder and director. He has over 20 years’ cybersecurity experience with an emphasis on offensive security techniques and security engineering in the IoT, industrial and transport arenas. Campbell is a founding director of both the TigerScheme and the CyberScheme. Twitter: @zyx2k
